answer: A swarm of fake identities becomes a hollow island cut off from the garden of real work, since cloning costs escalate with every bonded node while rewards stay gated behind genuine peer attestation. Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified hardware root, and reputation accrues only from attested peer interactions. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
